ex.en: You can choose whatever you like for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚餐你想吃什么都可以选。

ex.en: Whatever their background, students should have equal access to high-quality education and appropriate learning support.
ex.zh: 无论背景如何，学生都应平等地获得优质教育和适当的学习支持。

col: whatever the reason｜无论原因是什么
whatever you like｜任何你喜欢的东西
tip: whatever不限范围；whichever常指限定范围内任选。

ex.en: This cup is cracked, so please bring me another.
ex.zh: 这个杯子裂了，请再给我拿一个。

ex.en: Another reason to invest in public transport is its potential to reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通的另一个理由是，它有望减少城市空气污染。

tip: 通常接单数名词；another two days表示再两天。

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。

ex.en: Show me an easier way to fold this sheet.
ex.zh: 教我一个更简单的叠床单方法吧。

ex.en: Improving public transport is an effective way to reduce traffic congestion and urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通是减少交通拥堵和城市空气污染的有效方法。

col: an effective way｜一种有效的方法
tip: “做某事的方法”可用way to do或way of doing。

senses.en: a polite question asking permission to enter a room

ex.en: Tom knocks on the classroom door and asks, "May I come in?"
ex.zh: 汤姆敲了敲教室的门问道：“我可以进来吗？”

ex.en: Before stepping into the teachers' office, every polite student knocks gently and asks, "May I come in?"
ex.zh: 走进老师办公室前，每位有礼貌的学生都会轻轻敲门并问：“我可以进来吗？”

tip: 非常礼貌的请求许可句型，主语I无论在句首还是句中都要大写。
